result.instructions: Tools for Rackbeat, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find products with low available stock in Rackbeat."; "Show stock by warehouse location for this product."; "Which sales orders are ready for shipping?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rackbeat data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rackbeat_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rackbeat_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rackbeat_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. rackbeat_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rackbeat_account
tools.title: Read Rackbeat account
tools.description: Read the connected Rackbeat account and user IDs, company name and readiness. Omits addresses and email details.

tools.name: rackbeat_products
tools.title: Search Rackbeat products
tools.description: Read one bounded page of product summaries, stock and available quantities. Optional search and barred/sellable filters are sent to Rackbeat. Does not change inventory.

tools.name: rackbeat_get_product
tools.title: Read Rackbeat product stock
tools.description: Read one product's pricing and inventory quantities using its product number. Does not change stock, pricing or product data.

tools.name: rackbeat_product_locations
tools.title: Read Rackbeat stock by location
tools.description: Read stock and available quantities for one product across warehouse locations. only_toplevel is an upstream filter. offset/limit slice a bounded complete upstream response locally; very large responses require the Rackbeat dashboard.

tools.name: rackbeat_orders
tools.title: Search Rackbeat sales orders
tools.description: Read one bounded page of sales order summaries, totals and shipment/invoice status. Optional search, customer number and status filters are sent to Rackbeat. Does not book, cancel or ship orders.

tools.name: rackbeat_get_order
tools.title: Read Rackbeat sales order
tools.description: Read an order summary plus a bounded page of line quantities and prices. line_offset/line_limit slice locally after fetching one complete order within the response-size limit. Omits attachments, addresses and notes. Does not change the order.

tools.name: rackbeat_customers
tools.title: Search Rackbeat customers
tools.description: Read one bounded page of customer number, name, company, currency and barred/deleted status. Optional text search is sent to Rackbeat. Omits contact details, addresses and payment settings.
